name: markdown-formal
description: Agent-native, runtime-zero-dependency formal mathematics markdown assistant

scripts.build: npm run build:extension && npm run build:cli && npm run build:webview
scripts.build:cli: npm run typecheck:cli && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts
scripts.build:cli:quiet: npm run --silent typecheck:cli && vite build --config vite.cli.config.ts --logLevel warn
scripts.build:webview: npm run typecheck:webview && vite build --config vite.webview.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run formal -- verify
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:migrations
scripts.prepack: npm run content:build && npm run build
scripts.release:local: npm run content:build && npm test && node out/cli/release.js
